# Continuous integration

[Project overview](../../README.md) · [Documentation](../../docs/README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

Validate the public snapshot and produce reviewable manufacturing packages on pull requests.

[ci.yml](ci.yml) installs pinned validation dependencies, checks folder guides, verifies artifact/source hashes and mesh evidence, and builds the two PCB packages plus housing package.

CI validates committed KiCad/CAD evidence; it does not rerun native KiCad, fabricate boards or test hardware. A `rev*` tag triggers engineering prerelease publication after checks. Development uses pull requests into `main`.

There is deliberately no `.github/README.md`: GitHub would display it instead of the root product overview. The README generator and release validator guard this precedence rule.
